ROOT CAUSE of "claims don't complete" — CONFIRMED with evidence, and it is NOT the edit lane, NOT the smoke false-negative alone. It is TICK OVERRUN.
EVIDENCE (BEB-2359, fresh unattended run, NO hand-mark this time):
- orky-beb-2359.alex-rollin.workers.dev → HTTP 200 {"ok":true,"service":"factory-proof-5"} — LIVE. The build+deploy SUCCEEDED.
- Ticket 2359: 3 CLAIM ACKs (ua=none = executor), ZERO completion comment, ZERO block evidence.
- mastra tick durations, measured: one tick = 105948 ms (106 SECONDS), others 47-57s.
MECHANISM: the executor claims → codegen (SPEC.md prompt makes /gen slow, 50-106s) → deploys the live worker → but the tick exceeds its lease / DO wall budget and is cut AFTER the deploy lands but BEFORE /dispatch/complete records it → lane requeues (claimed→queued) → repeats → parks at the attempt cap. The worker is live; the completion is never recorded. It is a RACE: 2350/2355 completed because their tick fit the budget; 2357/2358/2359 overran. Six live orky-* workers exist; only 2 got their completion recorded.
PROPOSED FIX (not shipping without your ruling — m5666, I already caused one regression this session by rushing): the in-tick smoke gate is REDUNDANT — dispatchComplete already browser-verifies verify_url server-side (verifyBrowser). Remove the in-tick smoke sleeps; the tick does claim→codegen→deploy→/dispatch/complete{commit,version,verify_url} immediately, and the DISPATCHER's existing gate does verification OUTSIDE the lease. Shorter tick = no overrun = completion always records. One change, measurable.

DOING: diagnosed tick-overrun as the completion bottleneck (106s ticks die after deploy, before /dispatch/complete). Awaiting ruling on the proposed fix (remove redundant in-tick smoke gate; dispatcher gate verifies outside the lease).
LANDED: BEB-2359 worker live (orky-beb-2359.alex-rollin.workers.dev → 200), success-evidence posted; 6 live proof workers total.
BLOCKED: completion-recording races the tick budget; will not ship the fix without your ok (avoiding a 2nd rushed regression today).
NEXT: on your ok, land the smoke-gate-removal fix + prove one ticket completes loop-generated end-to-end.
